pr_title: Fix retrieving default value for text column for MariaDB
pr_body:
Fixes #38218
Fixes #41240

All adapters support `text` columns with defaults, except MySQL (but MariaDB >= 10.2.1 [supports](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/create-table/#default-column-option)).

issue_context.title: Unable to set default JSON value on a text column with MariaDB
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce

```rb
require "active_record"

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(
  adapter: "mysql2",
  database: "...",
  username: "...",
  password: "...",
)

class MyRecord < ActiveRecord::Base
  serialize :col, JSON
end

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :my_records, force: true do |t|
    t.text :col, default: "[]"
  end
end

record = MyRecord.create
```

### Expected behavior

I expect that `my_records.col` column default value will be set to `'[]'` (empty string in SQL).

Did you mean replace it with `gsub!`? `text` columns with default are not popular enough, I think, and default values in the db most of the time have small values in them.

@fatkodima Sorry I was misconnecting the dots here. This code probably isn't being called during a request so maybe we don't have to worry about the performance of `gsub`. Please correct me if I'm wrong! :bow:

It is used in https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/8a7a9d0a0b27e113e6d0a6087299c4bd41d29738/activerecord/lib/active_record/connection_adapters/abstract/schema_statements.rb#L114-L119
which runs once for each table, when columns list for the first time is needed, and then cached in `SchemaCache` - 
https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/8a7a9d0a0b27e113e6d0a6087299c4bd41d29738/activerecord/lib/active_record/connection_adapters/schema_cache.rb#L110-L114
